subject: IAM evidence request for SIG / SOC2 review - Bedrock Health
messages:
From: Sam Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bedrockhealth.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Bedrock Security <security@bedrockhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: IAM evidence for SIG / SOC2 review

Hi Laura,

We kicked off our SIG/SOC2 intake and need an initial bundle of IAM artifacts for our compliance team. Can you send the following for the Bedrock account (we've attached the scope doc to the intake form):

- Recent SCIM delta export (last 30 days) or a sample delta showing adds/changes/removes
- A couple of SAML assertion samples (successful auth, and an expired/failed assertion sample if possible)
- RBAC mapping: list of roles, owners, and least-privilege justification for any "admin"-like roles
- Any service-account provisioning/runbook notes and where service accounts are documented

Timing: our audit window opens 2027-02-01. Would appreciate a workback/ETA and any redaction rules you require. If there's an NDA/doc to sign first, please send that and we'll get it back quickly.

Thanks,
Sam Ortiz
Security Program Manager
Bedrock Health

--
Attached: Bedrock_IAM_scope_v1.pdf (referenced in HubSpot intake)
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Sam Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bedrockhealth.com>
Cc: Bedrock Security <security@bedrockhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 12:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: IAM evidence for SIG / SOC2 review

Sam — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble this; below is a proposed deliverable plan and a few clarifying asks. Happy to adjust based on your audit team's needs.

Proposed plan (deliver by 2027-01-25):
- SCIM: full delta export (CSV) for the last 30 days. We'll redact PII per our redaction_guidelines.pdf and also include a mapping file of SCIM attributes we export.
- SAML: two assertion samples (successful + expired) with headers and timestamps. We will redact user identifiers and include assertions in XML format.
- RBAC: role roster (CSV), role owner contact, and short justification for any roles with elevated privileges.
- Service accounts: catalog (service_account_registry.csv) + runbook pointer (internal runbook link).

Clarifying asks:
1) Do you need raw assertion logs or just the assertion XML? Raw logs contain IPs and timestamps that may require stricter redaction.
2) For RBAC justifications, do you prefer short bullets per-role or a single narrative?

I'll coordinate with our engineering team to pull the SCIM delta and assertions. I'll also open a DocuSign for a simple NDA if your procurement requires it.

Deliverables will be uploaded to a secure share and we'll post the HubSpot record.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Security & Trust Lead
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments referenced: redaction_guidelines.pdf (we'll include), initial_workback.csv (stub)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bedrockhealth.com>, Bedrock Security <security@bedrockhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: IAM evidence for SIG / SOC2 review

Looping in the technical notes. Sam — quick heads up on what we'll provide and how: 

- SCIM export: we'll run `redwood-scim-export --since=2026-12-19 --format=csv --anonymize=email,phone` and provide a delta CSV. Columns: op, id, userName, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails, groups, meta.lastModified.
- SAML: sample assertion files will be pulled from our assertion archive. We'll include the full <Assertion> XML but redact Subject > NameID and any recipient URLs.
- Session traces: we can produce a session-anchored log (timestamp + event) but we'll remove full IP addresses (showing first two octets only) unless Bedrock explicitly needs full IPs in writing.

Packaging: we'll create a top-level index.csv describing each file and the redaction applied.

If taxonomies/role names differ from your expected naming, include a small mapping table and we can adapt the RBAC export.

--
Aditya Rao
Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Sam Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bedrockhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: IAM evidence for SIG / SOC2 review

Thanks team — a couple operational notes from the SOC2 side:

- Audit window: Bedrock's stated window (2027-02-01) gives us about two weeks from the requested deliver-by date. We should aim to have the redaction and index finalized by 2027-01-24 to allow a one-business-day handoff and any follow-up.
- Redaction policy: we'll follow the attached redaction_guidelines.pdf. For anything flagged as "sensitive" (full IPs, MFA tokens, raw auth cookies) we should provide a controlled excerpt and offer to run a live readout with Bedrock security if they need more context.
- Delivery mechanism: secure share + short-lived links (7 days) + audit of downloads. If Bedrock needs longer retention on specific artifacts for their auditor, we'll accept a written request and log approvals.

I'll take ownership of the RBAC export once Aditya drops the role roster. Laura — please confirm if you want me to produce the one-paragraph justifications per-role or if you prefer to pass that to engineering leads.

Rishi
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bedrockhealth.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Bedrock Security <security@bedrockhealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: IAM evidence for SIG / SOC2 review

Thanks Laura / Aditya / Rishi — this looks good. Confirming:

- We prefer redacted artifacts by 2027-01-25 with the index.csv included. If anything can't be redacted safely, we'll request a short live session.
- For RBAC justifications, one-paragraph bullets per-role work best for our SOC2 reviewer.
- Please send the NDA/DocuSign link and we'll sign that so you can share full artifacts.

I'll update the HubSpot intake (link below) and add a note to our auditor.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=00000000
HubSpot intake: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/5678

Appreciate the quick turnaround — let me know if you need anything from procurement.

Best,
Sam
Security Program Manager
Bedrock Health
